description: Transvaalbuurt-West 1922-23 portiek blocks (Albert Luthulistraat 29-31 and 37-39): a dark red-brown brick front of four storeys, one big white three-light window either side of a broad brick stair tower that rises about 4 m over the 11.8 m wall top; the tower's stair windows sit on its axis between header-course brick ladders, a flat concrete canopy over the portiek door at its foot; a dark glazed-brick parapet band with hanging dentils under a thin coping runs the row and crowns the tower

match.note: the tower pands of the 1922-23 Albert Luthulistraat rows (BAG 1923; 3DBAG eaves 15.2-15.3 m read the tower); the strip skyline reads the tower top (15.7 m on 128866), 3DBAG eaves 15.2-15.3 m. No roof criterion: the setback fifth storey behind the parapet reads as a 3.0-3.6 m roof rise on 3DBAG. The two types are told apart by that skyline (frontSkylineM). Frontage: BAG cuts the 1921-1923 portiek rows into stair blocks of 5.2-12.4 m (Albert Luthulistraat 21-41: 5.2-5.7 m stair pands beside 9.2-12.4 m window pands; Schalk Burgerstraat 2-140 5.2-10 m) for one front, so the house width is no veto; four storeys at the type pitch and a 1.6-6.5 m window-axis pitch (3 axes over 5.6-12.4 m) are. A 0.8 m pitch (Retiefstraat 220: 12 columns over 9.4 m) is a plain window grid, not this front

tower.note: Albert Luthulistraat 29-31 (142206): wall top 11.8 m, tower 2.25-8.95 m from the pand's left, top 15.9 m (rise 4.1 m = 1.44 upper storeys), the dark band with dentils under the coping and again under the tower top

door-centre.note: the portiek door on the stair axis under a flat concrete canopy (2.65-3.15 m, about 3.5 m wide); mailboxes either side

rhythm.bays: a window bay, the broad stair tower, a window bay
rhythm.identicalBays: no: the tower bay is broad
rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: window + portiek door + window | 1-3: window + stair window + window
rhythm.groundFloor: one portiek door under a flat concrete canopy, two windows
rhythm.roofline: flat, a dark brick parapet band with dentils; the tower a storey and a half over it
